title: Prime Minister congratulates shooter Elavenil Valarivan on winning Silver Medal at the Asian Games
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has congratulated shooter Elavenil Valarivan on winning the Silver Medal in the Women’s 10m Air Rifle Individual event at the Asian Games. Shri Modi said that Indian shooters continue to make the nation proud.
Shri Modi posted on X:
Indian shooters keep making us proud!
Congrats to Elavenil Valarivan for winning a Silver Medal in the 10m Air Rifle Women Individual event at the Asian Games. This was her second medal of the day, making this even more special. My best wishes to her for the endeavours ahead: PM @narendramodi
